whenToUse: Right click actions on a file, row or canvas area, such as copy, paste, share and delete
Toggles and single choice settings changed from a right click, such as visible bars or the theme
Long command lists split into headed sections, key hints or a nested flyout of extra tools

whenNotToUse.when: Actions that must stay discoverable, opened from a visible button like a row's more icon
A persistent bar of File, Edit and View lists across the top of an app window
Site links in a header bar whose panels open on hover or click

agentNotes: Each dashed `ContextMenuTrigger` stands in for your target; wrap the row or card in it, or pass it through `render` on base and `asChild` on radix
`ContextMenuLabel` throws on the base twin outside a `ContextMenuGroup` or `ContextMenuRadioGroup`; the radix one renders anywhere
